text: や　やっぱ　こわいもんな　ブルブル

structure.jp: や　やっぱ　こわいもんな
structure.en: y-yeah, it is scary after all

patterns.name: 〜もの (reason)
patterns.explanation: もん is a spoken short form of もの, added at the end to give a reason with feeling: 'because, well...'. な asks for agreement. こわいもんな = 'because it's scary, right'.
